name: Sword formation
look: Flying-sword formation strike from cultivation fantasy. Eight slim spirit swords, pale steel blades edged in cyan light with small gold guards, gather one by one behind the caster (the left figure), fan out into a ring behind the caster's back, points outward, then dive one after another at the enemy (the right figure), each trailing a thin cyan streak.
subject: swords

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the ring of exactly eight swords alone as it is held behind the caster, points outward, evenly spaced, with no trails, no glow and no specks

parts.name: SWORD
parts.text: one spirit sword alone, upright, blade, guard and hilt clear
forms: pointing up and to the right, diagonal, a sword of the ring
pointing down and to the right, steep, as it dives
flying fast as a short bright streak, the blade barely seen
tumbling as it scatters, seen edge-on, dim

parts.name: TRAIL
parts.text: one diving sword's thin cyan light trail alone, fading toward its tail

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: the flash where a sword strikes, cyan sparks, metal glints, a gathering speck of light

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the ring of swords, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes: the swords, opaque, with no glow, no trails, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: trails, sparks, flashes, glints and specks, with no sword and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the swords and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: GATHER
rows.caption: swords gather
rows.text: eight swords appear one after another behind the caster's back, each from a speck of light, and stack upright behind the caster
notes: only a speck of light behind the caster and the first sword forming
two or three swords behind the caster, upright
all eight swords upright behind the caster, side by side

rows.name: RING
rows.caption: ring holds
rows.text: the eight swords fan out together into the ring behind the caster's back, exactly as MAIN, and hold it, the points glinting; it loops
notes: the eight upright swords starting to fan out together
the ring exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet
the ring held, glints on a few points
the ring held, the same as the second frame

rows.name: DIVE
rows.caption: swords dive
rows.text: the swords leave the ring one after another and dive at the enemy along a curve, each trailing a cyan streak, and strike it with a flash
notes: the first sword turning toward the enemy, seven still in the ring
the first sword in flight, a second turning
the first sword striking the enemy with a flash, more in flight
half the ring empty, swords in flight and striking
the last sword in flight, flashes at the enemy
the ring empty, swords in the enemy, flashes fading

rows.name: SCATTER
rows.caption: swords scatter
rows.text: the swords that struck spring back off the enemy, tumble, and fade into cyan specks
notes: only dim tumbling swords and specks
a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels

rules: There are always exactly eight swords; never more, never fewer.
The left figure is the caster and the right figure is the enemy: the swords gather behind the caster and strike the enemy. Draw neither figure.
Keep the colours of the second image's palette: no outline in black, no gradients wider than a few pixels.
